==Russian==

===Etymology===
From {{m|ru|ронить}}, from {{inh|ru|orv|ронити}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*roniti}}.
Cognate with {{cog|sh|ро̀нити}}, {{cog|pl|ronić}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|роня́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-ронять.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|роня́ть|impf|pf=урони́ть}}

# to [[drop]] (something), usually [[unintentionally]]

====Conjugation====
{{ru-conj|impf|1a|роня́ть|ppp=-}}
